Reentrancy in ERC20EnglishAuction._refundOutbid(address,uint256) (src/auction/ERC20EnglishAuction.sol#194-203):
	External calls:
	- this.payOutbidRefund{gas: REFUND_GAS}(bidder,amount) (src/auction/ERC20EnglishAuction.sol#196-202)
	State variables written after the call(s):
	- refundLiability += amount (src/auction/ERC20EnglishAuction.sol#200)
	- refunds[bidder] += amount (src/auction/ERC20EnglishAuction.sol#199)

Reentrancy in ERC20EnglishAuction._refundOutbid(address,uint256) (src/auction/ERC20EnglishAuction.sol#194-203):
	External calls:
	- this.payOutbidRefund{gas: REFUND_GAS}(bidder,amount) (src/auction/ERC20EnglishAuction.sol#196-202)
	Event emitted after the call(s):
	- RefundDeferred(bidder,amount) (src/auction/ERC20EnglishAuction.sol#201)
	- RefundPaid(bidder,amount) (src/auction/ERC20EnglishAuction.sol#197)

ERC20EnglishAuction.settle() (src/auction/ERC20EnglishAuction.sol#120-128) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- block.timestamp < endsAt (src/auction/ERC20EnglishAuction.sol#123)

ERC20EnglishAuction.constructor(ERC20EnglishAuction.AuctionConfig) (src/auction/ERC20EnglishAuction.sol#75-98) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- config.paymentToken.code.length == 0 || config.treasury == address(0) || config.treasury == address(this) || config.startsAt <= block.timestamp || config.duration == 0 || config.duration > 2592000 || config.extensionWindow == 0 || config.extensionWindow > config.duration || config.incrementBps == 0 || config.incrementBps > MAX_BPS (src/auction/ERC20EnglishAuction.sol#77-81)

ERC20EnglishAuction._handleBid(uint256) (src/auction/ERC20EnglishAuction.sol#154-180) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- settled || block.timestamp < startsAt || (started && block.timestamp >= endsAt) (src/auction/ERC20EnglishAuction.sol#158)
	- extended > endsAt (src/auction/ERC20EnglishAuction.sol#178)
